reports.title: Grindr Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Revenue Growth of 22%, Raises 2026 Guidance and Provides Initial 2027 Outlook

lines: Reports Third Quarter 2026 Revenue Growth of 22%, Raises 2026 Guidance and Provides Initial 2027 Outlook
Provides initial 2027 outlook for Revenue of at least $705 Million and Adjusted EBITDA of at least $275 Million
We are again raising our 2026 guidance, to $560 million in revenue and $236 million in Adjusted EBITDA.

Q3 2026 The Global Gayborhood in Your Pocket™ DELIVERING ON OUR LONG TERM TARGETS A FULL YEAR EARLY Our increased 2026 outlook puts us within the $234 million to $252 million Adjusted EBITDA range we envisioned for 2027 at our 2024 Investor Day, with revenue at roughly 93% of our 2027 target.

We’re delivering on our Investor Day financial ambitions a year early Based on our increased 2026 outlook Revenue 93% of our Investor Day 2027 revenue target 0% 100% Adjusted EBITDA $236M within our $234–252M Investor Day 2027 range This fall, we are taking two major steps toward that bigger ambition: launching Edge, our AI-powered premium tier, and bringing Freddie into Grindr.

With the acquisition complete, we now own an established, profitable, and rapidly growing telehealth business, expanding Grindr Health alongside Woodwork. 2026 outlook 2026 outlook $236M Investor Day 2027 target range $234M $252M Shareholder Letter 4
